note: seekWrap = seek(totalSec), which the studio clock wraps onto the loop; seekEnd = the last landing frame (expected to differ: the landing echoes, not repeats, the hook).
seamNote: seamDelta = mean abs RGB diff (fraction of full scale) of seek(0) vs seek(totalSec), the deliver.mjs wrap measure; mp4LastVsFirst = decoded MP4 frame N-1 vs frame 0; audioSeam = last-vs-first sample jump (click), silence before the first onset (a gap at the loop point) and tail-vs-head RMS step over the EBU R128 momentary window (400 ms) of the offline score; the 20 ms values are reported, not gated (they measure the hook attack, not a level).
